note: Hand-written expectations for the extraction distinctions the output must make. Each check is grounded in a section of the official Pydantic V2 migration guide (pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/). Regexes match path names, descriptions, condition statements, expected values, search patterns and migration steps, not evidence quotes. No check covers known incompatibilities: the guide states none.

checks.source: Changes to pydantic.BaseModel: dict() is deprecated and replaced by model_dump().
@validator and @root_validator are deprecated; Changes to config (orm_mode); Changes to pydantic.generics.GenericModel (__root__ replaced by RootModel). Independent changes that need separate paths.
Removed in Pydantic V2: pydantic.ConstrainedInt, pydantic.ConstrainedStr, ... (Constrained types section).
Type conversion from floats to integers: in V2 conversion is only allowed if the decimal part is zero.
Required, optional, and nullable fields: f3: Optional[str] is required and can be None; Any fields no longer default to None.
TypeError is no longer converted to ValidationError in validators.
Url and Dsn types in pydantic.networks no longer inherit from str; convert with str(url).
BaseSettings has moved to pydantic-settings, a separate package.
Color and Payment Card Numbers moved to pydantic-extra-types, which may be installed separately.
Changes to config: orm_mode has been removed (renamed from_attributes).
Changes to config: creating a class called Config in the namespace of a BaseModel subclass is now deprecated; use model_config.
@validator has been deprecated, and should be replaced with @field_validator.
Continue using Pydantic V1 features: the V2 package provides the V1 API by importing through pydantic.v1 (an alternative to migrating each usage).
